core.notes:
The menu lists "installed twice" and "needs a newer AWOO+" warnings under their own Attention heading, apart from your modules
Right after AWOO+ updates, it checks for updates straight away instead of waiting up to two hours, so the next step (like the move to one script) is offered at once
While your old second script (the extras one) is still installed beside the single AWOO+ script, a glowing amber Delete old script button sits in the top bar until you delete it; click it for how, or to be reminded tomorrow
